body: Decision recorded. ADR-0008 adopts priority -> created_at -> id for actionable-task ordering via one shared comparator (byPriorityThenCreatedAtThenId) reused by nextTask, readyTasks, auditPromotableTasks, and index-backed readyFromIndex; missing created_at sorts earliest; id is the final tiebreak. Explicit rank rejected for now (priority already the control axis; schema/migration/surface cost disproportionate without usage evidence) and no deferred status added. Decision record written. Smoke test confirmed in-memory and --from-index agree (oldest first). 226 tests, tsc + biome clean.
